steps.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import socket
import urllib.request


def show(label, attempt):
    try:
        attempt()
        print(label, 'ok')
    except OSError as e:
        print(label, type(e).__name__, e)


show('connect', lambda: socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1', 9), timeout=3))
show('connect by name', lambda: socket.create_connection(('example.com', 80), timeout=3))
quiet = socket.socket()
quiet.setblocking(False)
show('non-blocking connect', lambda: quiet.connect(('127.0.0.1', 9)))
show('udp sendto', lambda: socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM).sendto(b'x', ('127.0.0.1', 9)))
show('http', lambda: urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:9/', timeout=3))
show('https', lambda: urllib.request.urlopen('https://example.com/', timeout=3))
tcp = socket.socket()
show('tcp bind', lambda: tcp.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0)))
show('tcp listen', tcp.listen)
show('udp bind', lambda: socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM).bind(('127.0.0.1', 0)))
show('socketpair', socket.socketpair)
PY
